maddeler.e:
تنتهكوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَهِكُوا (tantahikū) /tan.ta.hi.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# تُنْتَهَكُوا (tuntahakū) /tun.ta.ha.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
